title: Architecture Board
summary: Governance body that approves architecture decisions above the agreed threshold and decides on exceptions and cross-domain conflicts.
body_markdown:
# Architecture Board

## Purpose

Provide a legitimate, cross-domain decision forum.

## Responsibilities

- Approve significant ADRs.
- Grant or refuse exceptions to principles.
- Resolve cross-domain conflicts.
- Monitor architecture compliance.

## Decision Rights

Data architecture level above threshold; exceptions to principles.

## Inputs

ADRs; impact analyses; review reports.

## Outputs

Governance decisions (recorded with the Governance Decision Template).

## Required Competencies

Composite: enterprise, data, security architects and business representatives.

## Escalation Paths

Strategic issues → executive management.
